author: mattishotaf
body: I really think we should have a credit system, because, some people, like me, are still at a young age and if they can only buy something once in a while and they are waiting for a coupon or a new item we could do it in credits, and exchange the credits for things like a rank, pets, kits, or XP. Please give me some feedback on this idea, it would really help, Thanks. -Matt
